title: Prefixes — the basics
note: B1 tranche of the affix programme (James, 2026-08-18). un- / in- (im-) / dis- / re- with a choose-the-prefix review block. Czech glosses display only. 6 blocks × 12.

cards.title: What a prefix does
points: The sentence tells you when the meaning is negative.
A prefix goes on the FRONT of a word and changes its meaning

rows: unhappy is still an adjective, lock → unlock is still a verb.

cards.title: un- — the everyday negative
points: un- is the most common negative in English.
On verbs it reverses the action: lock → unlock, pack → unpack.

cards.title: in- / im- and dis-
points: in- becomes im- before p: possible → impossible, polite → impolite.
dis- works on verbs too: agree → disagree, appear → disappear.
Careful: discover is not the opposite of cover — not every dis- word is negative.

cards.title: re- = again
points: re- means again or back — it is not negative.
Often the new word is its own word: remind, replace, return.

items.en: She failed the test and was very unhappy about it.
items.cz: Neuspěla u testu a byla z toho velmi nešťastná.
items.gap: She failed the test and was very ____ about it.
items.explanation: She failed — the feeling is negative: un- + happy.
items.explanation_cz: Neuspěla — pocit je negativní: un- + happy.

items.en: That's unfair! You got two cakes and I got none.
items.cz: To je nefér! Ty jsi dostal dva koláče a já žádný.
items.gap: That's ____! You got two cakes and I got none.
items.explanation: A complaint: un- + fair.
items.explanation_cz: Stížnost: un- + fair (nespravedlivé).

items.en: The old bridge is unsafe — don't cross it.
items.cz: Starý most není bezpečný — nechoď přes něj.
items.gap: The old bridge is ____ — don't cross it.
items.explanation: 'Don't cross it' — the bridge is dangerous: un- + safe.
items.explanation_cz: 'Nechoď přes něj' — most je nebezpečný: un- + safe.

items.en: His room is always untidy — clothes everywhere.
items.cz: Jeho pokoj je pořád neuklizený — všude oblečení.
items.gap: His room is always ____ — clothes everywhere.
items.explanation: Clothes everywhere = not tidy: un- + tidy.
items.explanation_cz: Všude oblečení = neuklizeno: un- + tidy.

items.en: It is unusual to see snow here in May.
items.cz: Vidět tady v květnu sníh je neobvyklé.
items.gap: It is ____ to see snow here in May.
items.explanation: Snow in May is not normal: un- + usual.
items.explanation_cz: Sníh v květnu není normální: un- + usual.

items.en: Eating chips every day is unhealthy.
items.cz: Jíst každý den hranolky je nezdravé.
items.gap: Eating chips every day is ____.
items.explanation: Chips every day — bad for you: un- + healthy.
items.explanation_cz: Hranolky každý den — škodí: un- + healthy.

items.en: It was unkind of you to laugh at him.
items.cz: Bylo od tebe nehezké se mu smát.
items.gap: It was ____ of you to laugh at him.
items.explanation: Laughing at someone is not kind: un- + kind.
items.explanation_cz: Smát se někomu není hezké: un- + kind.

items.en: He apologised because the story he told was untrue.
items.cz: Omluvil se, protože příběh, který vyprávěl, nebyl pravdivý.
items.gap: He apologised because the story he told was ____.
items.explanation: He apologised — so the story was false: un- + true.
items.explanation_cz: Omluvil se — příběh byl nepravdivý: un- + true.

items.en: Don't worry — it's an unimportant detail.
items.cz: Neboj se — to je nedůležitý detail.
items.gap: Don't worry — it's an ____ detail.
items.explanation: 'Don't worry' — it doesn't matter: un- + important.
items.explanation_cz: 'Neboj se' — na tom nezáleží: un- + important.

items.en: Students hate the new rule — it is very unpopular.
items.cz: Studenti nové pravidlo nesnášejí — je velmi neoblíbené.
items.gap: Students hate the new rule — it is very ____.
items.explanation: They hate it: un- + popular.
items.explanation_cz: Nesnášejí ho: un- + popular (neoblíbené).

items.en: His answer was unclear, so I asked again.
items.cz: Jeho odpověď byla nejasná, tak jsem se zeptal znovu.
items.gap: His answer was ____, so I asked again.
items.explanation: I had to ask again — I did not understand: un- + clear.
items.explanation_cz: Musel jsem se zeptat znovu: un- + clear (nejasná).

items.en: Don't bring money — it's unnecessary.
items.cz: Neber si peníze — není to potřeba.
items.gap: Don't bring money — it's ____.
items.explanation: 'Don't bring' — you don't need it: un- + necessary.
items.explanation_cz: 'Neber si' — není třeba: un- + necessary.

items.en: The door is locked — can you unlock it for me?
items.cz: Dveře jsou zamčené — můžeš mi je odemknout?
items.gap: The door is locked — can you ____ it for me?
items.explanation: It is already locked — you need the opposite action: un- + lock.
items.explanation_cz: Už je zamčeno — potřebuješ opačnou akci: un- + lock.

items.en: You can undo the last change with Ctrl+Z.
items.cz: Poslední změnu můžeš vrátit pomocí Ctrl+Z.
items.gap: You can ____ the last change with Ctrl+Z.
items.explanation: un- + do = take the action back.
items.explanation_cz: un- + do = vzít akci zpět.

items.en: We arrived at the hotel and unpacked our bags.
items.cz: Přijeli jsme do hotelu a vybalili si tašky.
items.gap: We arrived at the hotel and ____ our bags.
items.explanation: You pack at home, and un-pack when you arrive. Past form.
items.explanation_cz: Doma balíš, po příjezdu vybaluješ: un- + packed.

items.en: The doctor asked him to undress.
items.cz: Doktor ho požádal, aby se svlékl.
items.gap: The doctor asked him to ____.
items.explanation: un- + dress = take clothes off.
items.explanation_cz: un- + dress = svléknout se.

items.en: Unplug the TV before you clean it.
items.cz: Před čištěním televizi odpoj ze zásuvky.
items.gap: ____ the TV before you clean it.
items.explanation: un- + plug = take it out of the socket.
items.explanation_cz: un- + plug = odpojit ze zásuvky.

items.en: The writer of this old song is unknown.
items.cz: Autor téhle staré písně je neznámý.
items.gap: The writer of this old song is ____.
items.explanation: Nobody knows the name: un- + known.
items.explanation_cz: Nikdo nezná jméno: un- + known (neznámý).

items.en: She did a year of unpaid work for the charity.
items.cz: Rok dělala pro charitu neplacenou práci.
items.gap: She did a year of ____ work for the charity.
items.explanation: Charity work — no money: un- + paid.
items.explanation_cz: Práce pro charitu — bez peněz: un- + paid.

items.en: His last book stayed unfinished.
items.cz: Jeho poslední kniha zůstala nedokončená.
items.gap: His last book stayed ____.
items.explanation: un- + finished = never completed.
items.explanation_cz: un- + finished = nedokončený.

items.en: Give unwanted clothes to the charity shop.
items.cz: Nechtěné oblečení dej do charitativního obchodu.
items.gap: Give ____ clothes to the charity shop.
items.explanation: Clothes you don't want any more: un- + wanted.
items.explanation_cz: Oblečení, které už nechceš: un- + wanted.

items.en: There are two hundred unread emails in my inbox.
items.cz: Ve schránce mám dvě stě nepřečtených e-mailů.
items.gap: There are two hundred ____ emails in my inbox.
items.explanation: Not read yet: un- + read.
items.explanation_cz: Ještě nepřečtené: un- + read.

items.en: Grandma was unable to climb the stairs.
items.cz: Babička nebyla schopná vyjít schody.
items.gap: Grandma was ____ to climb the stairs.
items.explanation: She could not do it: un- + able.
items.explanation_cz: Nedokázala to: un- + able (neschopná).

items.en: The knot is too tight — I can't untie it.
items.cz: Uzel je moc utažený — nemůžu ho rozvázat.
items.gap: The knot is too tight — I can't ____ it.
items.explanation: The knot exists — the problem is the opposite action: un- + tie.
items.explanation_cz: Uzel už existuje — jde o opačnou akci: un- + tie.

items.en: Check numbers 3 and 5 again — they are incorrect.
items.cz: Zkontroluj znovu čísla 3 a 5 — jsou nesprávně.
items.gap: Check numbers 3 and 5 again — they are ____.
items.explanation: 'Check again' — something is wrong: in- + correct.
items.explanation_cz: 'Zkontroluj znovu' — něco je špatně: in- + correct.

items.en: Wear jeans — the party is informal.
items.cz: Vezmi si džíny — večírek je neformální.
items.gap: Wear jeans — the party is ____.
items.explanation: Jeans = no dress code: in- + formal.
items.explanation_cz: Džíny = žádný dress code: in- + formal.

items.en: In the thick fog the path was almost invisible.
items.cz: V husté mlze nebyla cesta skoro vidět.
items.gap: In the thick fog the path was almost ____.
items.explanation: Thick fog — you cannot see it: in- + visible.
items.explanation_cz: Hustá mlha — není vidět: in- + visible.

items.en: Your form is incomplete — the address is missing.
items.cz: Tvůj formulář je neúplný — chybí adresa.
items.gap: Your form is ____ — the address is missing.
items.explanation: Something is missing: in- + complete.
items.explanation_cz: Něco chybí: in- + complete (neúplný).

items.en: Students like the hostel because it is clean and inexpensive.
items.cz: Studenti mají hostel rádi, protože je čistý a levný.
items.gap: Students like the hostel because it is clean and ____.
items.explanation: Students like it — so it is cheap: in- + expensive.
items.explanation_cz: Studentům se líbí — je levný: in- + expensive.

items.en: It is impolite to point at people.
items.cz: Je nezdvořilé ukazovat na lidi.
items.gap: It is ____ to point at people.
items.explanation: in- becomes im- before p: im- + polite.
items.explanation_cz: Před p se in- mění na im-: impolite.

items.en: The copy is imperfect — you can see small mistakes.
items.cz: Kopie není dokonalá — jsou vidět malé chyby.
items.gap: The copy is ____ — you can see small mistakes.
items.explanation: im- before p: im- + perfect.
items.explanation_cz: Před p je im-: imperfect (nedokonalý).

items.en: We took a longer, indirect route through the villages.
items.cz: Jeli jsme delší cestou oklikou přes vesnice.
items.gap: We took a longer, ____ route through the villages.
items.explanation: Longer and through the villages — not straight: in- + direct.
items.explanation_cz: Delší, přes vesnice — ne přímo: in- + direct.

items.en: The country became independent in 1918.
items.cz: Země se stala nezávislou v roce 1918.
items.gap: The country became ____ in 1918.
items.explanation: No longer ruled by others: in- + dependent.
items.explanation_cz: Už nepodléhá jiným: in- + dependent (nezávislý).

items.en: Don't worry, the volcano has been inactive for centuries.
items.cz: Neboj, sopka je už staletí nečinná.
items.gap: Don't worry, the volcano has been ____ for centuries.
items.explanation: 'Don't worry' — it does nothing: in- + active.
items.explanation_cz: 'Neboj' — nic nedělá: in- + active (nečinná).

items.en: He felt insecure about speaking English.
items.cz: Cítil se nejistě, když měl mluvit anglicky.
items.gap: He felt ____ about speaking English.
items.explanation: Not sure of himself: in- + secure.
items.explanation_cz: Nejistý sám sebou: in- + secure.

items.en: They protested against injustice.
items.cz: Protestovali proti nespravedlnosti.
items.gap: They protested against ____.
items.explanation: You protest against the bad thing: in- + justice.
items.explanation_cz: Protestuje se proti špatnému: in- + justice.

items.en: We always disagree about politics — we never share the same opinion.
items.cz: V politice se vždycky neshodneme — nikdy nemáme stejný názor.
items.gap: We always ____ about politics — we never share the same opinion.
items.explanation: Never the same opinion: dis- + agree.
items.explanation_cz: Nikdy stejný názor: dis- + agree (neshodovat se).

items.en: The sun disappeared behind the clouds.
items.cz: Slunce zmizelo za mraky.
items.gap: The sun ____ behind the clouds.
items.explanation: It went out of sight: dis- + appeared.
items.explanation_cz: Zmizelo z dohledu: dis- + appeared.

items.en: She dislikes loud music, so she left the concert early.
items.cz: Hlasitou hudbu nemá ráda, a tak z koncertu odešla dřív.
items.gap: She ____ loud music, so she left the concert early.
items.explanation: She left early — she does not like it: dis- + likes.
items.explanation_cz: Odešla dřív — nemá to ráda: dis- + likes.

items.en: The soldier was punished because he disobeyed the order.
items.cz: Voják byl potrestán, protože neuposlechl rozkaz.
items.gap: The soldier was punished because he ____ the order.
items.explanation: Punished — so he did NOT follow the order: dis- + obeyed.
items.explanation_cz: Potrestán — rozkaz nesplnil: dis- + obeyed.

items.en: His desk is a mess — he is completely disorganised.
items.cz: Na stole má nepořádek — je úplně nepořádný.
items.gap: His desk is a mess — he is completely ____.
items.explanation: A mess: dis- + organised (US disorganized — both accepted).
items.explanation_cz: Nepořádek: dis- + organised.

items.en: The internet stopped because the cable was disconnected.
items.cz: Internet přestal fungovat, protože kabel byl odpojený.
items.gap: The internet stopped because the cable was ____.
items.explanation: The internet stopped — the cable was out: dis- + connected.
items.explanation_cz: Internet nefungoval — kabel byl odpojený: dis- + connected.

items.en: After the lie, she felt deep distrust of him.
items.cz: Po té lži k němu cítila hlubokou nedůvěru.
items.gap: After the lie, she felt deep ____ of him.
items.explanation: After a lie you stop trusting: dis- + trust.
items.explanation_cz: Po lži důvěra mizí: dis- + trust (nedůvěra).

items.en: Talking during the anthem shows disrespect.
items.cz: Mluvit během hymny je projev neúcty.
items.gap: Talking during the anthem shows ____.
items.explanation: It is rude: dis- + respect.
items.explanation_cz: Je to neuctivé: dis- + respect (neúcta).

items.en: The injection causes only small discomfort.
items.cz: Injekce způsobí jen malé nepohodlí.
items.gap: The injection causes only small ____.
items.explanation: An injection is unpleasant: dis- + comfort.
items.explanation_cz: Injekce je nepříjemná: dis- + comfort (nepohodlí).

items.en: Her parents disapprove of her new boyfriend — they never smile at him.
items.cz: Rodiče jejího nového přítele neschvalují — nikdy se na něj neusmějí.
items.gap: Her parents ____ of her new boyfriend — they never smile at him.
items.explanation: They never smile at him: dis- + approve.
items.explanation_cz: Nikdy se na něj neusmějí: dis- + approve (neschvalovat).

items.en: Scientists discover new stars every year.
items.cz: Vědci každý rok objevují nové hvězdy.
items.gap: Scientists ____ new stars every year.
items.explanation: dis- + cover = find something hidden. Not every dis- word is negative!
items.explanation_cz: dis- + cover = objevit. Ne každé dis- je záporné!

items.en: A disloyal friend tells your secrets.
items.cz: Neloajální kamarád vyzrazuje tvá tajemství.
items.gap: A ____ friend tells your secrets.
items.explanation: Telling secrets is betrayal: dis- + loyal.
items.explanation_cz: Vyzrazovat tajemství je zrada: dis- + loyal.

items.en: Please return the books to the library by Friday.
items.cz: Vrať prosím knihy do knihovny do pátku.
items.gap: Please ____ the books to the library by Friday.
items.explanation: re- + turn = give back / go back.
items.explanation_cz: re- + turn = vrátit.

items.en: The old bridge was destroyed and rebuilt two years later.
items.cz: Starý most byl zničen a o dva roky později znovu postaven.
items.gap: The old bridge was destroyed and ____ two years later.
items.explanation: Destroyed, then built AGAIN: re- + built.
items.explanation_cz: Zničen a postaven ZNOVU: re- + built.

items.en: The essay is full of mistakes — please rewrite it.
items.cz: Esej je plná chyb — přepiš ji prosím.
items.gap: The essay is full of mistakes — please ____ it.
items.explanation: It exists but is bad — write it AGAIN: re- + write.
items.explanation_cz: Existuje, ale je špatná — napsat ZNOVU: re- + write.

items.en: The colours are wrong — we must redo the poster.
items.cz: Barvy jsou špatně — plakát musíme udělat znovu.
items.gap: The colours are wrong — we must ____ the poster.
items.explanation: Do it again from the start: re- + do.
items.explanation_cz: Udělat znovu: re- + do.

items.en: Let's watch the replay of the goal.
items.cz: Podívejme se na opakovaný záběr gólu.
items.gap: Let's watch the ____ of the goal.
items.explanation: Played again on screen: re- + play.
items.explanation_cz: Přehráno znovu: re- + play (opakovaný záběr).

items.en: We recycle glass and paper at home.
items.cz: Doma recyklujeme sklo a papír.
items.gap: We ____ glass and paper at home.
items.explanation: Material goes round again: re- + cycle.
items.explanation_cz: Materiál jde znovu do oběhu: re- + cycle.

items.en: If the app freezes, restart your phone.
items.cz: Když aplikace zamrzne, restartuj telefon.
items.gap: If the app freezes, ____ your phone.
items.explanation: The phone is on — start it AGAIN: re- + start.
items.explanation_cz: Telefon běží — zapnout ZNOVU: re- + start.

items.en: Can I get a refill of coffee, please?
items.cz: Můžu dostat dolít kávu, prosím?
items.gap: Can I get a ____ of coffee, please?
items.explanation: The cup was full before: re- + fill.
items.explanation_cz: Šálek už byl plný: re- + fill (dolití).

items.en: You must renew your passport — it expired in May.
items.cz: Musíš si obnovit pas — v květnu mu skončila platnost.
items.gap: You must ____ your passport — it expired in May.
items.explanation: Make it valid again: re- + new.
items.explanation_cz: Zajistit novou platnost: re- + new (obnovit).

items.en: Click here to refresh the page.
items.cz: Klikni sem pro obnovení stránky.
items.gap: Click here to ____ the page.
items.explanation: Load it fresh again: re- + fresh.
items.explanation_cz: Načíst znovu: re- + fresh (obnovit).

items.en: The battery is dead — we need to replace it.
items.cz: Baterie je vybitá — musíme ji vyměnit.
items.gap: The battery is dead — we need to ____ it.
items.explanation: Put a new one in its place: re- + place.
items.explanation_cz: Dát na její místo novou: re- + place (vyměnit).

items.en: Please remind me to call the dentist tomorrow.
items.cz: Připomeň mi prosím, ať zítra zavolám zubaři.
items.gap: Please ____ me to call the dentist tomorrow.
items.explanation: Bring it back to my mind: re- + mind.
items.explanation_cz: Vrátit do mysli: re- + mind (připomenout).

items.en: All my answers were incorrect — I got zero points.
items.cz: Všechny mé odpovědi byly nesprávné — dostal jsem nula bodů.
items.gap: All my answers were ____ — I got zero points.
items.explanation: correct takes in-: incorrect. (uncorrect and discorrect do not exist.)
items.explanation_cz: correct má in-: incorrect. (uncorrect a discorrect neexistují.)

items.en: It's impossible to learn Czech in a month.
items.cz: Naučit se česky za měsíc je nemožné.
items.gap: It's ____ to learn Czech in a month.
items.explanation: possible takes im- (before p): impossible.
items.explanation_cz: possible má im- (před p): impossible.

items.en: He was dishonest — he kept the money he found and told nobody.
items.cz: Byl nepoctivý — nalezené peníze si nechal a nikomu nic neřekl.
items.gap: He was ____ — he kept the money he found and told nobody.
items.explanation: honest takes dis-: dishonest.
items.explanation_cz: honest má dis-: dishonest (nepoctivý).

items.en: Her desk is always untidy — nothing is ever in its place.
items.cz: Její stůl je pořád neuklizený — nic není na svém místě.
items.gap: Her desk is always ____ — nothing is ever in its place.
items.explanation: tidy takes un-: untidy.
items.explanation_cz: tidy má un-: untidy (neuklizený).

items.en: The brothers disagree about everything, so they rarely talk.
items.cz: Bratři se neshodnou na ničem, a tak spolu skoro nemluví.
items.gap: The brothers ____ about everything, so they rarely talk.
items.explanation: agree takes dis-: disagree.
items.explanation_cz: agree má dis-: disagree.

items.en: I can't open it — can you unlock the door?
items.cz: Nemůžu to otevřít — odemkneš ty dveře?
items.gap: I can't open it — can you ____ the door?
items.explanation: lock takes un- for the reverse action: unlock.
items.explanation_cz: Opačná akce k lock je s un-: unlock.

items.en: Stars are invisible in the city because of the lights.
items.cz: Hvězdy nejsou ve městě vidět kvůli světlům.
items.gap: Stars are ____ in the city because of the lights.
items.explanation: visible takes in-: invisible.
items.explanation_cz: visible má in-: invisible.

items.en: The computer is frozen — restart it.
items.cz: Počítač zamrzl — restartuj ho.
items.gap: The computer is frozen — ____ it.
items.explanation: Here you need AGAIN, not a negative: re- + start.
items.explanation_cz: Tady je potřeba ZNOVU, ne zápor: re- + start.

items.en: Arriving late without a phone call is impolite.
items.cz: Přijít pozdě bez zavolání je nezdvořilé.
items.gap: Arriving late without a phone call is ____.
items.explanation: polite takes im- (before p): impolite.
items.explanation_cz: polite má im- (před p): impolite.

items.en: My keys always disappear when I need them.
items.cz: Klíče mi vždycky zmizí, když je potřebuju.
items.gap: My keys always ____ when I need them.
items.explanation: They vanish: dis- + appear. (reappear = come back!)
items.explanation_cz: Zmizí: dis- + appear. (reappear = objevit se znovu!)

items.en: She stayed in an unpaid job because she loved it.
items.cz: Zůstala v neplacené práci, protože ji milovala.
items.gap: She stayed in an ____ job because she loved it.
items.explanation: paid takes un-: unpaid.
items.explanation_cz: paid má un-: unpaid (neplacený).

items.en: Glass and paper go in these bins — we recycle them.
items.cz: Sklo a papír patří do těchto košů — recyklujeme je.
items.gap: Glass and paper go in these bins — we ____ them.
items.explanation: Round again: re- + cycle.
items.explanation_cz: Znovu do oběhu: re- + cycle.
